metadata.title: Endpoint Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for defining the baseline trust requirements that establish an endpoint as an acceptable execution environment.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint devices, operating systems, firmware, enrollment services, and hardware roots of trust.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational pattern defining non-negotiable trust invariants required for an endpoint to participate in institutional systems.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint Core aligns with NIST guidance on foundational security controls and Zero Trust principles.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Endpoint identity, integrity, and resilience align with digital identity and platform firmware resilience guidance.

metadata.remarks: Endpoint Core defines the immutable trust properties that must be satisfied before an endpoint can be considered an acceptable execution environment. This pattern establishes enrollment, identity binding, baseline integrity, and observability requirements but does not define configuration hardening, posture evaluation, threat response, or lifecycle transitions.

components.title: Endpoint Enrollment and Accountability
components.description: Ensures endpoints are formally enrolled, uniquely identifiable, and attributable to an owner or custodian.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of unmanaged or improperly enrolled devices to access institutional systems.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Formal enrollment and identity binding prevent anonymous or unmanaged endpoint access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Devices are uniquely identified and authenticated prior to system access.
An inventory of authorized endpoints is maintained.

components.title: Endpoint Identity Binding
components.description: Binds endpoint identity to cryptographic and hardware-backed identifiers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Spoofing or reuse of endpoint identity through exposed or copied credentials.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Hardware-backed identity binding prevents cloning or reuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Endpoint identity mechanisms are protected against compromise.

components.title: Baseline Integrity Assurance
components.description: Establishes baseline integrity for firmware, boot chain, and operating system.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through modification of firmware or boot components.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Secure boot and measured boot protect baseline integrity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanisms are in place to detect unauthorized changes to system components.

components.title: Endpoint Observability
components.description: Ensures endpoint actions, state changes, and security-relevant events are observable.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of endpoint evidence to evade detection.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit and telemetry ensure accountability and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit events are reviewed to identify anomalies.
